content:
Rumors suggest that Apple has been working hard to significantly revamp its Home product line, and a new data leak has listed several anticipated products.

macOS code leak mentions multiple unreleased Home devices

Apple's annual most important launch event is just around the corner, where it is expected that, in addition to the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, and the next generation of Apple Watch models, all-new Home products will also be unveiled.

Rumors indicate that an all-new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad are about to debut, but there are also several other Home products that may launch in the short term.

Yesterday, MacRumors discovered that the newly released macOS 26.7 RC version contains information related to multiple unreleased products.

These include codenames tied to Home devices, as pointed out by Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be the home hub version with a base, while J491 is the wall-mountable version."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): The internal codename for HomePod mini is B520, so this codename is very likely to belong to the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Very likely the much-rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Reappearing codenames for unknown Home devices.
  • ATVRemote1,5: Next-generation Siri Remote, expected to debut alongside the all-new Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic-style home hub. It is currently unclear whether their codenames are included in the macOS 26.7 data leak.

In addition to the products, MacRumors also discovered a "Pebble" string, believed to be the internal codename for homeOS. Additionally, there is an "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning" string, which may be related to the HomePad.

Finally, an unspecified Home accessory was found in the leaked data to come in four colors: Rose Pink, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.

Best Apple Home accessory recommendations

  • eufy 4K camera (supports HomeKit Secure Video)
  • Aqara smart lock (supports Apple Home Key and UWB)
  • HomeKit garage door opener
  • HomeKit smart plug (four-pack)
  • Aqara smart thermostat (supports adaptive temperature feature)
